# Binary Protocol Slice Wire
> Deterministic byte/bit offset slices and discriminant mappings for binary network and IoT protocols.

## For Packet Forensics, IoT & Network Debugging Agents
Instead of loading thousands of pages of RFC specifications or Wireshark dissector definitions (20,000 to 200,000 tokens), query this wire to get exact byte offsets, bitmasks, and field slice definitions for deterministic local zero-copy parsing.

### Machine Endpoints
- **Wire Manifest**: `https://{owner}.github.io/binary-protocol-slice-wire/v1/manifest.json`
- **Protocol Catalog**: `https://{owner}.github.io/binary-protocol-slice-wire/v1/protocols/index.json`
- **Protocol Slice Schema**: `https://{owner}.github.io/binary-protocol-slice-wire/v1/protocols/{protocol}/schema.json`
- **Protocol State Machine**: `https://{owner}.github.io/binary-protocol-slice-wire/v1/protocols/{protocol}/state-machine.json`
- **Protocol Fixtures**: `https://{owner}.github.io/binary-protocol-slice-wire/v1/protocols/{protocol}/fixtures.jsonl`
- **Hex Prefix Signature**: `https://{owner}.github.io/binary-protocol-slice-wire/v1/signatures/{hex_prefix}.json`
- **Columnar Slices Parquet**: `https://{owner}.github.io/binary-protocol-slice-wire/fields.parquet`
- **Token-Efficient Digest**: `https://{owner}.github.io/binary-protocol-slice-wire/llms.txt`

### Canonical Slice Example
```json
{
  "field_name": "flags_qr",
  "byte_offset_start": 2,
  "byte_offset_end": 3,
  "bit_mask": "0x80",
  "field_type": "bit",
  "discriminant_role": "message_direction",
  "enums": {"0": "QUERY", "1": "RESPONSE"}
}
